levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Skips or reorders steps, for example wiping before sorting.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Completes all four steps in the modeled order.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Completes all four steps in order and self-corrects when they notice they skipped one.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Has no clear sense of which step took longest.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Accurately names which step took longest.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names the longest step and explains a specific reason tied to that space.

lookFors: Sort step produces two distinguishable groups, not one big pile.
Wipe step happens only after the surface is fully cleared.
Reflection compares before and after using a specific detail from the space, not a general statement.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
